ajf-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：焦夫机场的跑道铺在沙特北部的沙漠中，航站楼与机坪在跑道一侧，周围是旱地与少量农田。
ajf-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Al-Jawf's runway lies in the northern Saudi desert, with the terminal and apron alongside it and dry land and a few fields around.

ajf-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 深绿色玻璃幕墙的航站楼入口上方，用英文和阿拉伯文写着焦夫国际机场。
ajf-chatgpt-01.webp.en: The glass front of the terminal carries Al Jouf International Airport in English and Arabic above its entrance doors.

ajf-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 值机大厅里空无一人，一排编号柜台亮着蓝色屏幕，地面光可鉴人。
ajf-chatgpt-02.webp.en: The check-in hall stands empty, a row of numbered counters glowing blue beneath bright ceiling lights on a polished floor.

ajf-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 从空中看，双车道公路穿过沙漠通向航站楼，路口中央是一座圆形环岛。
ajf-chatgpt-03.webp.en: Seen from above, a divided road runs across bare desert through a roundabout toward the airport terminal.

ajf-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 明亮的白色网格天花板下，粗大圆柱撑起一座开阔的候机大厅，这里不像是焦夫的小航站楼。
ajf-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Beneath a white lattice ceiling, broad columns hold up a vast polished concourse that looks far larger than Al-Jouf's compact terminal.

ajf-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 两股水柱在窄体客机上方交叉，机坪外是干燥荒凉的沙地。
ajf-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Two water jets cross above a narrow-body jet on the apron, with dry desert stretching beyond the airfield fence.

ajf-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 日落后天边泛着橙紫色，灯光勾勒出焦夫国际机场航站楼与门前的棕榈环岛。
ajf-chatgpt-06.webp.en: After sunset an orange-and-purple sky glows behind the lit Al Jouf terminal, its approach road lined with palms.

ajf-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 夕阳把焦夫机场的老航站楼染成金色，一架尾翼带绿色标志的客机停在登机口旁。
ajf-chatgpt-07.webp.en: Low sunlight turns Jouf Airport's older terminal golden while an airliner with a green tail stands at the gate.
